links.outcome: Statement accuracy and data credibility/source quality of custom delirium LLM outputs versus SLRs
links.effect: DELSTAR gave more accurate, comprehensive information than SLRs (p < 0.05), but mainly relied on less reliable internet sources; improvements needed in high-quality data use and citation.
links.quote: DELSTAR demonstrated more accurate and comprehensive information compared to information retrieved by traditional systematic literature reviews (SLRs) (p < 0.05) and accessed Application Programmer Interfaces (API), private databases, and high-quality sources despite mainly relying on less reliable internet sources.

unlisted_practices: Comparing foundation models for a domain-specific custom GPT using F1, sensitivity, specificity, precision, AUC
Benchmarking a customised LLM against traditional systematic literature reviews

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark accuracy and data credibility of a custom LLM pipeline (DELSTAR) against systematic literature review datasets without testing an operational deployment practice.
